item.title: Remembering David Frederick
item.description: David Frederick passed away suddenly at his home in Shreveport, aged 57, on January 30, 2026. David was born in Florida and moved to Shreveport with his family while in school. item.title: Isabella CPA & Advisory opens in Shreveport
item.description: A new business has officially opened in Shreveport. Isabella CPA & Advisory, LLC held a ribbon-cutting ceremony on Feb. 19 to mark the launch of its services in the area. The firm provides accounting and advisory services to local individuals and businesses. Paid Content
